title: papaver somniferum subsp. opiiferum
intro: Papaver somniferum subsp. opiiferum, commonly known as opium poppy, is a subspecies of the opium poppy plant (Papaver somniferum) that is cultivated for its medicinal and psychoactive properties. The health benefits of opium poppy include pain relief, cough suppression, and sedation, making it a valuable resource in traditional medicine. The therapeutic actions of opium poppy are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including alkaloids such as morphine, codeine, and thebaine, which exert analgesic, antitussive, and sedative effects. Additionally, the bioactive constituents of opium poppy include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other compounds that contribute to its medicinal properties.
